fib: ______ refer to principles, norms, rules and decision-making procedures around which actors expectations converge in a given issue area.
Regimes refer to principles, norms, rules and decision-making procedures around which actors expectations converge in a given issue area.
______ is an agreement creating binding obligations between subjects of international law.
A convention is an agreement creating binding obligations between subjects of international law.
______ is an approach to bargaining between states engaged in a crisis in which threats to use arms or inflict high financial costs are made to force an adversary to reach a compromise.
Coercive diplomacy is an approach to bargaining between states engaged in a crisis in which threats to use arms or inflict high financial costs are made to force an adversary to reach a compromise.
______ means that participants in the international system have similar ideas about what rules will govern their mutual participation, each expects to play by the same rules.
The convergence of expectations means that participants in the international system have similar ideas about what rules will govern their mutual participation, each expects to play by the same rules.
______ is the UN Security Council, which is made up of five great powers and ten rotating members that make decisions about international peace and security.
Parallel to the General Assembly is the UN Security Council, which is made up of five great powers and ten rotating members that make decisions about international peace and security.
______ is a new court that has not been fully tested.
The International Criminal Court by contrast is a new court that has not been fully tested.
